summary: Tested editable Venture Path module names (super_admin admin panel). Backend: added TestModuleNameOverrides class (14 tests) covering GET/PUT auth (401/403/200), shape (14 modules/defaults/allowed_icons), full override persist + saved_count, partial override fallback to defaults, invalid-module-400, invalid-icon-400, name truncation to 80 chars, E2E propagation to /api/student/venture-path, and hierarchy check (cohort milestone title beats admin override beats code default). All 14 pass. Frontend: seeded super_admin session, verified 'Venture Path' nav btn appears on /admin, navigation to /admin/venture-path renders 14 module cards, editing module 2 name+icon+save shows success toast, values persist after reload, Reset restores defaults in-memory only (not persisted), and student navigating to /admin/venture-path is redirected to /dashboard.

issues: Student briefly sees a 'Super admin only' error toast before the redirect to /dashboard fires because VenturePathAdmin's load() runs before the role-check useEffect navigates away. Minor UX polish — could gate the load() behind the role check to avoid the flash of 403 toast.

action_items: (Optional polish) In VenturePathAdmin.js, guard load() with `if (user?.role !== 'super_admin') return;` inside the useEffect to prevent the '403 Super admin only' toast flash when a student mistakenly navigates to /admin/venture-path.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints /api/admin/venture-path-modules correctly gate on super_admin and merge overrides using stripped/empty-fallback logic in _get_venture_path_modules_merged — good design allowing partial overrides.
Hierarchy is code_default -> admin_override (via merged) -> curriculum milestone title (applied later in _compute_venture_path_for_student). Verified by tests. Documented behaviour matches spec.
Name truncated to 80 chars, tagline to 160 — good bounds. Icon whitelist enforced with 400 + allowed list in error detail — good UX for the admin editor.
Minor: VenturePathAdmin.js load() fires even for non-super_admin users, causing a flash 403 toast before redirect. Add a role guard inside the load useEffect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (nav btn, page render, 14 cards, edit+save, persistence, reset in-memory, student redirect)

test_credentials: Super admin slewis@theboostpad.org used indirectly (session token seeded directly into user_sessions collection for the pre-existing super_admin user).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests self-seed TEST_ prefixed users/sessions/cohorts/assignments and clean up. Frontend test seeded a TEST_uitok_* session for the existing super_admin and a temporary TEST_uistu_* student — both cleaned up after run. platform_settings._id='venture_path_modules' overrides doc cleared post-run.

To run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cohort-feedback-hub.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database pytest backend/tests/test_venture_path.py::TestModuleNameOverrides -v`. rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a minor UX polish suggestion (flash toast for students navigating to /admin/venture-path).
